title: Police Knew She Was Hiding Something...
description:
This 20 year old thought she could get away with speeding after giving the officers a fake name. The female tried her best to maintain her story when she was questioned by another officer who later arrived on the scene but couldn’t provide any physical evidence of her fake name. Apart from providing a fake ID, a search of her car revealed that the female was also carrying weed without a proper license. The female was charged with providing a false ID to a law enforcement officer.
